settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Dolphins and Colts, scheduled for November 15 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Colts" if the Colts win the game by 2 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Dolphins".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

In the upcoming NFL football game between Rams and Cardinals, scheduled for November 15 at 4:05 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Rams" if the Rams win the game by 6 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Cardinals".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

teamAlerts.name: Carson Beck
teamAlerts.detail: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Beck will serve as the Cardinals' No. 2 quarterback behind starter Gardner Minshew in Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

teamAlerts.name: Gardner Minshew II
teamAlerts.detail: Head coach Mike LaFleur announced that Minshew will step in as the Cardinals' new starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Seattle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

teamAlerts.name: Matthew Stafford
teamAlerts.detail: Stafford completed 26 of 43 passes for 228 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 20-13 win over the Commanders. He added one yard on his only carry.

teamAlerts.name: Ty Simpson
teamAlerts.detail: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback in Sunday's game against the Commanders, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Seahawks and Raiders, scheduled for November 15 at 4:05PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if Seahawks win the game.
This market will resolve to "Raiders" if Raiders win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Seahawks and Raiders, scheduled for November 15 at 4:05PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if Seahawks win the game.
This market will resolve to "Raiders" if Raiders win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
